title: Anime Angels (feat. Tomozero)
description:
Anime Angels (feat. Tomozero) is a tile-swapping puzzle game with pictures of pretty anime girls.

Swap tiles to piece together the beauty of the suggestive artwork. Progress through the picture sets, gradually revealing more and more.

Discover beautiful anime art drawn by the professional artist トモゼロ (Tomozero).
 
• One-handed gameplay: Play effortlessly with mouse, keyboard, or controller.

• High-quality art: Dive into 8 captivating picture sets with 3-4 steps each (25 pictures).

• Quick solve option: Instantly view the full artwork with auto-complete.

Enjoy a blend of puzzles and passion, where each solved artwork becomes your reward.
description_short: Solve tile-swapping puzzles to unveil pretty anime girls drawn by the artist トモゼロ (Tomozero).
